acceptance_criteria.condition: An explicit runtime or resource budget requires visible-scale complexity reasoning and a deterministic boundary probe before completion.
The rule does not pretend hidden scale is known and preserves a residual-risk statement when no safe contract bound exists.

invariants: Public tests remain necessary but are not sufficient evidence for a stated performance budget.
Hidden tests and unavailable production scale remain unknown rather than being inferred.

safeguards.name: budget-aware completion gate
safeguards.rationale: The normative Skill rule requires scale inspection, worst-case resource reasoning, and a boundary probe when a budget is explicit.

design_boundary.rationale: The Skill owns the AI workflow gate; project test and benchmark tooling remain the enforcement surface.

dependency_audit.rationale: The change adds prose and a standard-library contract test only.

data_ownership.rationale: No application or personal data is handled.

error_model.rationale: Unknown scale is recorded as residual risk rather than promoted to verified budget compliance.

contract_evolution.rationale: The README summary is updated with the same normative rule and a regression test protects the wording.

operational_budget.rationale: The rule specifically requires a resource budget signal and a visible-scale check.

threat_boundary.rationale: No privileged or sensitive operation changes.

delivery_lifecycle.rationale: The Skill, README, test, and evidence artifact will be delivered in one atomic commit.

operational_knowledge.rationale: README documents the new completion rule and its evidence boundary.

reproducibility.rationale: A standard-library contract test verifies the exact policy text and can run in a clean environment.

verification.result: The Skill contract suite passes, including the explicit-budget boundary-probe rule.

rollback_or_compatibility: Revert SKILL.md, README.md, the contract regression, and this artifact together; existing projects continue to use the prior budget safeguard matrix.

independent_review.notes: The rule is narrowly scoped to explicit budgets and does not claim hidden-scale knowledge.

supporting_artifacts.summary: Regression assertion for scale reasoning, boundary probe, and residual-risk wording.

remaining_risks: The rule improves the workflow contract but does not itself execute a profiler or guarantee hidden performance cases.
